topics.title: Standard Deviation and Variance, Explained From Scratch
topics.visual: two dot clouds with the same mean, one tight and one spread, every point's distance to the mean drawn as a bar that squares into a tile
topics.covers: spread as the question an average cannot answer, distance from the mean, why the deviations are squared instead of averaged raw, taking the square root to get back to the original units, a full worked calculation on five numbers, what one standard deviation covers on a bell curve, population versus sample and why the divisor changes
topics.notes: Made outside this repo (Lesson Lab script in channel/lesson-lab/standard-deviation). Mean vs Median's teaser leads here. Add the folder/branch if it lives elsewhere, and the YouTube link once uploaded.

topics.title: Mean Versus Median: Which Average Is Lying to You?
topics.visual: incomes on a number line with the mean riding a seesaw and the median standing on the middle person, one outlier dragging the seesaw away
topics.covers: the mean as a balance point and the median as the middle value, both computed on the same small set, what a single extreme value does to each, skew, when the mode is the honest answer, how reported averages mislead about salaries and house prices

production.youtube_title: Mean vs Median: Which Average Lies? | Machine Learning, Data Science, Finance & CS
production.running_example: Two towns (Maple, Pine Hill), nine household incomes each; Pine Hill mean 60k vs median 40k
production.hook: Two towns report the same average income of 60 thousand; 8 of 9 Pine Hill families earn less
